operations.name: Saw Cut – Tube Blanks
operations.setup_note: Load near-net seamless mechanical steel tube against a production length stop and saw individual blanks with facing allowance on both ends.

operations.name: CNC Turn – First End
operations.setup_note: Grip the saw-cut tube on its raw OD, face the first end to establish process datum A, and rough the concentric profile before sizing the through bore. Use a rigid or damped boring bar, then finish the OD profile and produce the first-end knurl and bore break without unloading.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Second End
operations.setup_note: Reverse the part onto a protected expanding mandrel located by finished bore datum B and first face datum A. Face to final overall length, complete the opposite flange and transition, and produce the second-end knurl and bore break.

operations.name: Production Deburr and Wash
operations.setup_note: Bench- or vibratory-deburr the completed parts, breaking remaining sharp edges to the drawing note, then wash away chips and cutting-fluid residue before phosphating.

operations.name: Phosphate Coat – PS-119.0
operations.setup_note: Process the complete order as a bulk-line batch where barrel capacity permits; perform line cleaning and activation immediately before applying phosphate coating per PS-119.0. All machining and edge breaking are complete before treatment.

operations.name: Final Shop-Floor Inspection
operations.setup_note: After coating, perform the standard sampling quality gate using plug gauges, snap gauges, and calipers for the bore, ODs, flange dimensions, and overall length, together with visual coating inspection. No dedicated CMM layout is required by the supplied notes.

operations.name: Periodic Crush Test – PS-122.10
operations.setup_note: Load control-plan sample parts in the dedicated compression fixture and run the specified PS-122.10 crush-load and displacement checks. This is a periodic sampled test rather than a 100 percent production operation.

clarifications.question: Is F02 a conventional cylindrical OD knurl or a radial serration pattern on each end face?
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat F02 as a cylindrical knurl on both end regions and produce it with a CNC-lathe knurling tool.

clarifications.question: What approved seamless mechanical tube size, stated as OD × ID, should be procured?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use near-net tubing providing approximately 1.0 mm diametral cleanup at the largest OD and approximately 1.0 mm diametral cleanup in the bore.

clarifications.question: What total facing allowance should be included in the saw-cut blank length?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use 6 mm total length allowance, divided between the two faced ends.

clarifications.question: Does PS-119.0 require the central bore to be masked during phosphate coating?
clarifications.suggested_default: Apply phosphate to the complete part without masking because the bore is not specified as H7 or tighter.

clarifications.question: What production-lot sampling frequency is required for the PS-122.10 crush test?
clarifications.suggested_default: Test one control-plan sample per production lot unless PS-122.10 specifies a different frequency.

clarifications.question: Is the PS-122.10 crush test destructive to the sampled component?
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat the crush test as destructive and manufacture replacement sample pieces beyond the shipment quantity.

assumptions.text: A and B are shop process datums rather than drawing-defined datums: A is the first finished end face and B is the finish-sized bore axis.
Precision seamless mechanical tubing is used instead of solid bar or a formed blank, consistent with ALM-STOCK-002 and the quantity of 100 pieces.
Pending clarification, F02 is routed as a lathe-produced knurl at both end regions; no milling, hobbing, or shaping operation is included.

The near-net tube bore requires one finish sizing pass only. Rough drilling, peck drilling, rough boring, reaming, tapping, and other hole-making template steps are omitted because no corresponding features exist and solid-core drilling is prohibited by ALM-STOCK-002.
Separate part-off and center-drilling steps are omitted because individual tube blanks are sawed before turning and the tubular part is not routed for between-centres machining.
No VMC operation is required because the feature graph contains no flats, slots, cross-holes, pockets, or off-axis features; the conditional ALM-VMC-001 examples therefore do not apply geometrically.

Phosphate masking, unmasking, and cure-bake steps are omitted unless PS-119.0 requires them. The supplied material is low-carbon steel, no heat treatment is specified, and the bore is not a precision H7 fit.
Surface-treatment inspection is consolidated into the final shop-floor manual inspection gate, and dedicated CMM inspection is omitted per ALM-INSP-001.
The controlled operation type pressure_test is used as the closest available representation of the specified mechanical crush-load test.
The two lathe setups are intentionally separate so both opposed ends can be faced, profiled, knurled, and chamfered without assuming a sub-spindle or simultaneous opposed-end machining capability.
